notes: Checked via gh api (repo, license, readme, strudel.json, folder listings, commits) plus Freesound licence pages for fjpolo's cited sounds; no audio downloaded, so 'contents' judgements rest on names and READMEs — a listening pass is still advisable. Verdict counts: {'ship-ok': 3, 'ship-after-owner-check': 4, 'do-not-ship': 11, 'link-only': 12}. Strudel's github: shortcut assumes branch 'main' — fstiffo/polifonia-samples needs '/master'. Of the 6 open-licence priority banks: 3 ship-ok (AuditeMarlow, fstiffo, hvillase), 2 ship-after-owner-check (emrexdeger: no provenance; fjpolo: MIT label over Freesound CC-BY + one CC BY-NC sound), 1 do-not-ship (Veikkosuhonen: Amen break, MIT covers code only). QuantumVillage/quantum-music is AGPL too (7th open-licence repo) but its sounds come from an OQC video. AustinOliverHaskell's MIT label is contradicted by its own README (Microsoft copyright). Dirt-Samples, which strudel.cc loads by default, fails this policy (no licence, unknown provenance, Amen). Good licence-request candidates: Dough-Juj, mysinglelise, wyan, mot4i (confirm CC-BY).
